search_rounds.name: contemporaneous_discovery
search_rounds.finding: The reviewed discovery record did not establish a qualifying Cumberland County operation before the 2009 anchor.

search_rounds.name: county_inventory_closure

reviewed_anchor.canonical_name: 123NET Southfield Data Center at 24700 Northwestern Highway

search_rounds.name: local_official_record
search_rounds.finding: The regulatory filing repeatedly locates current Ameritech systems at a Southfield data center by 2002.

search_rounds.name: operator_and_corporate_history
search_rounds.finding: 123NET documents the promoted facility as operating and recently expanded in 2014.

search_rounds.name: contemporaneous_discovery
search_rounds.finding: No reviewed contemporaneous source established the 123NET facility as Oakland County's first operation.

search_rounds.name: county_inventory_closure
search_rounds.finding: The earlier Ameritech operation rejects the candidate, while the exact historical inventory and building identity of the Ameritech operation remain incomplete.

earlier_operational_findings.finding: Ameritech's regulatory response identifies current systems and backups housed at a Southfield data center by 2002, twelve years before the promoted 123NET anchor.

records.rationale: The promoted 123NET 2014 anchor cannot be Oakland County's first entry because Ameritech's regulatory filing documents a Southfield data center supporting current systems by 2002. The filing does not resolve that earlier operation to an exact building, and the county inventory remains incomplete; therefore this decision rejects only the 2014 candidate and does not assign a replacement treatment date.

search_rounds.name: contemporaneous_discovery
search_rounds.finding: Contemporaneous reporting establishes Yahoo's opening, while the Air Force history identifies a much earlier continuously operating mainframe system at Offutt but does not establish that its former room was a qualifying data-center facility.

search_rounds.name: county_inventory_closure
search_rounds.finding: The Offutt lead prevents inventory closure until the historical system location, facility classification, and other institutional or military computing sites are resolved.

records.rationale: Yahoo's February 2010 La Vista opening remains the earliest qualifying exact-facility operation established in this round. The Air Force documents an uninterrupted mainframe core at Offutt for more than forty years before 2020, but it does not establish the former room as a qualifying data-center facility under this treatment definition. That lead and the incomplete military and institutional inventory prevent verification, so the candidate remains unresolved.
